source.text_it: I freni dei veicoli di massa complessiva a pieno carico superiore a 7,5 tonnellate sono raffreddati ad acqua

records.localized_text: Brakes on vehicles with total laden mass over 7.5 tonnes are water-cooled.

source.text_it: Sui veicoli a 3 assi, la frenatura è ripartita tra l’asse anteriore e uno dei due assi posteriori

records.localized_text: On three-axle vehicles, braking is distributed between the front axle and one of the two rear axles.

source.text_it: Gli autoveicoli devono essere dotati di 3 sistemi di frenatura: servizio, soccorso, stazionamento

records.localized_text: Motor vehicles must have three braking systems: service, emergency and parking.

source.text_it: La frenatura di stazionamento di un autoveicolo deve essere ad azione puramente meccanica

records.localized_text: A motor vehicle's parking brake must act purely mechanically.

source.text_it: La frenatura di servizio degli autoveicoli deve agire su tutte le ruote

records.localized_text: Motor vehicle service braking must act on all wheels.

source.text_it: La frenatura di servizio degli autoveicoli deve essere moderabile

records.localized_text: Motor vehicle service braking must be capable of modulation.

source.text_it: La frenatura di servizio degli autoveicoli deve essere azionabile dal conducente dal proprio posto di guida senza togliere le mani dal volante

records.localized_text: The driver must be able to operate service braking from the driving position without removing hands from the steering wheel.

source.text_it: La frenatura di soccorso deve essere moderabile

records.localized_text: Emergency braking must be capable of modulation.

source.text_it: La frenatura di soccorso viene normalmente realizzata con l’uso "a fondo" del freno di stazionamento

records.localized_text: Emergency braking is normally achieved by fully applying the parking brake.

source.text_it: La frenatura di stazionamento è in genere conglobata col servofreno

records.localized_text: Parking braking is generally incorporated into the brake booster.

source.text_it: La frenatura di servizio degli autoveicoli deve essere di tipo "a impulsi"

records.localized_text: Motor vehicle service braking must be pulse-type.

source.text_it: Il comando del freno di stazionamento è lo stesso del freno di servizio

records.localized_text: The parking brake uses the same control as the service brake.

source.text_it: Su tutti gli autoveicoli devono essere presenti idonei cunei per il fermo

records.localized_text: All motor vehicles must carry suitable wheel chocks.

source.text_it: Fanno parte dell’impianto di frenatura pneumatico il compressore e i serbatoi dell’aria compressa

records.localized_text: A pneumatic braking system includes a compressor and compressed-air tanks.

source.text_it: Quando il veicolo è in marcia, nell’impianto di frenatura pneumatico deve esservi sempre aria in pressione nel tratto di impianto compreso tra il compressore e il distributore duplex

records.localized_text: While driving, the pneumatic braking system must always contain pressurized air between the compressor and duplex valve.

source.text_it: Nell’impianto di frenatura pneumoidraulico (freno misto), i convertitori trasformano la pressione dell’aria in pressione idraulica

records.localized_text: In a pneumatic-hydraulic braking system, converters transform air pressure into hydraulic pressure.

source.text_it: L’impianto di frenatura pneumatico integrale o quello pneumoidraulico, sono divisi in più sezioni indipendenti, una per le ruote anteriori, una per quelle posteriori ed eventualmente una per il rimorchio

records.localized_text: Fully pneumatic and pneumatic-hydraulic braking systems have independent sections for front wheels, rear wheels and possibly a trailer.

source.text_it: Nei veicoli con impianto di frenatura ad aria compressa, appositi dispositivi modulatori regolano la pressione dell’aria diretta agli elementi frenanti dell’asse posteriore in base al carico del veicolo

records.localized_text: In air-braked vehicles, modulators adjust pressure sent to rear axle brakes according to vehicle load.

source.text_it: Se l’impianto di frenatura pneumatica o pneumoidraulica non è in pressione, il veicolo non può essere messo in movimento perché non è possibile disinserire il freno di stazionamento a molla

records.localized_text: If a pneumatic or pneumatic-hydraulic braking system has no pressure, the vehicle cannot move because the spring parking brake cannot be released.

source.text_it: Se l’impianto di frenatura è tipo pneumatico, prima della partenza è necessario accertarsi che nei serbatoi vi sia pressione sufficiente

records.localized_text: Before departure with pneumatic brakes, ensure tank pressure is sufficient.

source.text_it: Sugli autoveicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica, se si verifica una perdita di aria in una sezione dell’impianto di frenatura, le altre sezioni possono funzionare regolarmente; tale struttura costituisce il "freno di soccorso"

records.localized_text: If air leaks from one section of a pneumatic brake system, the others may work normally; this arrangement constitutes emergency braking.

source.text_it: A partire dalla valvola protezione serbatoi, l’impianto di frenatura di servizio ad aria compressa è costituito da due sezioni distinte più una eventuale per il rimorchio

records.localized_text: From the tank protection valve onward, the compressed-air service braking system has two separate sections plus an optional trailer section.

source.text_it: In caso di avaria in una sezione dei freni, anche se le altre sezioni funzionano, non si deve intraprendere un nuovo viaggio se non si è provveduto alla riparazione del guasto

records.localized_text: If one brake section fails, do not start a new journey until it is repaired, even if the others work.

source.text_it: I serbatoi dell’aria dei veicoli dotati di frenatura pneumatica o pneumoidraulica, sono normalmente: uno per ogni sezione dell’impianto, uno per i servizi ed eventualmente per le sospensioni pneumatiche

records.localized_text: Pneumatic or pneumatic-hydraulic brake air tanks normally include one for each system section, one for auxiliary services and possibly air suspension.

source.text_it: I serbatoi dell’aria compressa degli impianti di frenatura dei mezzi pesanti sono dotati di un dispositivo per lo scarico dell’acqua di condensa accumulatasi

records.localized_text: Heavy-vehicle compressed-air brake tanks have a device for draining accumulated condensation.

rows.text: A mass over 7.5 tonnes does not mean that brakes are water-cooled: the brake components dissipate the heat produced by friction.
evidence: Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Vehicle Braking Systems, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/vehicle-braking-systems: il calore è assorbito e dissipato dai componenti dei freni.

rows.text: The service brake acts on all wheels, so the second rear axle also contributes to braking.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §5.2.1.7.1 richiede l’azione del freno di servizio su tutte le ruote.

rows.text: Service, secondary and parking brakes have different functions: slowing the moving vehicle, stopping it after a failure, and holding it stationary. They may share components.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §§2.1.2 e 5.2.1.1-2 definiscono le tre funzioni e ammettono componenti comuni.

rows.text: The vehicle must be held stationary by purely mechanical action, even if another form of energy is used to apply the brake.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §2.1.2.3 richiede il mantenimento delle parti frenanti in posizione bloccata con un dispositivo puramente meccanico.

rows.text: The service brake acts on all wheels, distributing braking across the axles.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §5.2.1.7.1 dispone che il freno di servizio agisca su tutte le ruote.

rows.text: The driver must be able to adjust braking force as needed, rather than having only fully applied or released brakes.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §2.1.2.1 richiede una frenatura di servizio graduabile.

rows.text: The service brake control must be accessible from the driving position without releasing the steering wheel, allowing the driver to steer while braking.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §2.1.2.1 prevede azionamento dal posto di guida senza togliere le mani dallo sterzo.

rows.text: Secondary braking must also be adjustable, so the driver can control the stop if the service brake fails.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §2.1.2.2 richiede una frenatura di soccorso graduabile.

rows.text: Secondary braking must be adjustable: it does not normally consist of applying the parking brake fully. It can also be provided by the working part of the service brake.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §§2.1.2.2 e 5.2.1.2 consentono soccorso graduabile e componenti comuni; non prescrivono l’applicazione a fondo dello stazionamento.

rows.text: The parking brake holds the vehicle stationary by a mechanical device; the brake booster assists service braking.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §§2.1.2.1 e 2.1.2.3 distinguono servizio e mantenimento meccanico in sosta.

rows.text: The service brake must be adjustable, not required to operate in pulses: the driver adjusts the force with the control.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §2.1.2.1 prescrive frenatura graduabile.

rows.text: The parking brake control must be independent of the service brake control, although some components may be shared.
evidence: UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §§5.2.1.2.2 e 5.2.1.2.5 richiedono comandi indipendenti e consentono componenti comuni alle condizioni indicate.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSE: not all autoveicoli must carry wheel chocks. Chocks help prevent accidental rolling; rules require their use for heavy vehicles parked on steep gradients.
evidence: Official superiori question 30325, printed FALSO, rejects carriage for all autoveicoli; it does not identify a universal carriage category.

DPR 495/1992 art.353(2), https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592 — wheel chocks for qualifying heavy vehicles stopped on steep gradients; use condition, not proof of universal carriage obligation.

ASAPS guidance https://www.asaps.it/986-Comportamento_del_conducente_in_sosta_e_uso_di_cunei_fermaruote_per_i_veicoli_pesanti.html — heavy-vehicle chock use on steep grades; local inspected copy /tmp/rotonda-asaps-heavy-vehicle-chocks.txt.

rows.text: The compressor produces compressed air, and reservoirs store it as a reserve for the brake circuits.
evidence: Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Air Supply Subsystem, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem: il compressore alimenta i serbatoi e i due circuiti di servizio.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE: reservoirs and protected circuits must retain enough pressure for braking. The compressor cycles, however, and in some systems a discharge segment vents when cut-out pressure is reached. Without the layout, “always pressurized” cannot be assumed for every segment.
evidence: Original superiori question 30327, p.134, printed VERO asserts pressure throughout compressor-to-duplex path while driving; actual circuit layout unspecified.

WABCO Maintenance Manual 34 (revised 2020), printed p.34 (PDF p.37), https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/mm34_web.pdf — defines a discharge-line unloaded-compressor arrangement venting unused air to atmosphere at cut-out. Architecture-specific example, not assertion that all lines or protected reservoirs empty.

rows.text: In an air-over-hydraulic brake, the converter uses compressed-air force to create pressure in the hydraulic fluid that operates the brakes.
evidence: NHTSA, interpretation nht92-4.20, https://www.nhtsa.gov/interpretations/nht92-420: descrive convertitori aria-idraulica e trasmissione al fluido dei freni.

rows.text: Separate circuits serve the front and rear wheels and, where present, the trailer supply; this limits the effects of a leak in one section.
evidence: WABCO, Systems and Components in Commercial Vehicles, pp. 3-4, 19, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf: schema e valvola di protezione distinguono circuiti di servizio e alimentazione rimorchio; la valvola conserva pressione nei circuiti integri.

rows.text: The load-sensing device adjusts pressure to the rear brakes for the load: an unladen vehicle needs less force than a fully laden one.
evidence: WABCO, Systems and Components in Commercial Vehicles, pp. 3-4, 19, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf: p. 3, valvola sensibile al carico regola la pressione in funzione del carico sull’asse posteriore.

rows.text: The quiz marks this TRUE. On vehicles fitted with spring parking brakes, sufficient air is normally needed to release them; without pressure they may remain applied. The vehicle may nevertheless be physically movable: do not force it to move; stop safely and seek assistance.
evidence: Original superiori question 30331, p.134, printed VERO; not all pneumatic or pneumohydraulic vehicles have the same spring-brake arrangement.

Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/spring-parking-and-emergency-brake-subsystem — spring brakes apply as chamber pressure falls and normally release with air; many vehicles can still physically move with springs applied. Indexed government source text inspected; direct fetch may return 403. Physical possibility is not advice to move with applied brakes or inadequate pressure.

rows.text: Before setting off, check the pressure gauges: the reservoirs must contain enough air for the brakes to operate.
evidence: Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Air Supply Subsystem, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem: i manometri indicano la pressione dei serbatoi e la bassa pressione è un pericolo.

rows.text: The protection valve preserves pressure in intact sections if one leaks; the working section can provide secondary braking with reduced effectiveness.
evidence: WABCO, Systems and Components in Commercial Vehicles, pp. 3-4, 19, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf: p. 19, protezione dei circuiti integri; UN Regulation 13, paragrafi 2.1.2 e 5.2.1, https://unece.org/fileadmin/DAM/trans/main/wp29/wp29regs/r013r4e.pdf: §5.2.1.2.6 richiede il soccorso dopo guasti previsti.

rows.text: The protection valve separates the two service circuits and also protects the trailer supply, when present, from a leak in another circuit.
evidence: WABCO, Systems and Components in Commercial Vehicles, pp. 3-4, 19, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf: p. 19, uscite 21 e 22 per serbatoi di servizio, circuito 3 per stazionamento e alimentazione rimorchio.

rows.text: The remaining braking function is there to stop after a failure; it does not restore full performance, so the fault must be repaired before a new journey.
evidence: Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Inspecting Air Brake System Operation, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/inspecting-air-brake-system-operation: una perdita eccessiva rende difettoso l’impianto; Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Air Supply Subsystem, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem: un circuito residuo offre la funzione necessaria a fermare il veicolo.

rows.text: In the arrangement considered, brake sections have separate reserves; other tanks can supply auxiliary equipment and air suspension.
evidence: WABCO, Systems and Components in Commercial Vehicles, pp. 3-4, 19, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf: p. 19, serbatoi distinti per circuiti di servizio, circuito di stazionamento/rimorchio e ausiliari; Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Air Supply Subsystem, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem: il numero di serbatoi dipende dal veicolo. WABCO p. 112: l’impianto di sospensione pneumatica comprende alimentazione e riserva di aria compressa.

rows.text: Compressed air can deposit moisture in the tank: a drain valve allows accumulated condensation to be removed.
evidence: Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Air Supply Subsystem, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/air-supply-subsystem: la valvola sul fondo del serbatoio consente di scaricare umidità e olio.

reviewer_evidence: Compared all four localized explanations with source statements and verdicts. Inspected UN R13 in official EUR-Lex regulation 2026/746 §§2.1.2, 5.2.1.2 and 5.2.1.7.1; https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/746/oj (HTML JavaScript challenge; indexed PDF).

30327: WABCO maintenance manual 34 p.34 (PDF p.37), https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/mm34_web.pdf, supports a discharge-line unloaded-compressor example, not universal unloading of protected reservoirs. 30331: Ontario indexed official spring-brake handbook and Manitoba Air Brake Manual corroborate spring application and normal air release; Ontario direct page returned 403.

30325: https://www.asaps.it/986-Comportamento_del_conducente_in_sosta_e_uso_di_cunei_fermaruote_per_i_veicoli_pesanti.html locally inspected /tmp/rotonda-asaps-heavy-vehicle-chocks.txt lines 170–187: two chocks for vehicles over 3.5 tonnes in steep-grade parking; DPR 495 art.353(2) concerns use on steep gradients. These do not independently establish a universal carriage duty for every vehicle over 3.5 tonnes.

WABCO https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf timed out for reviewer; circuit concepts checked against Utah CDL air-brake handbook https://dld.utah.gov/cdl-manual-section-5-air-brakes/ and independent UN R13 requirements; exact WABCO pages not independently inspected.

Re-reviewed 30325 in all four languages: explains the printed FALSO and chock use for heavy vehicles on steep gradients, without an unconditional carriage claim; cited DPR 495 art. 353(2) and ASAPS use context verified. Other rows unchanged from full review.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata VERO richiede pressione sempre nell’intero tratto dal compressore al distributore duplex. Alcuni impianti scaricano verso atmosfera la mandata del compressore durante la fase di scarico; non è chiaro se il quesito presupponga un diverso schema e quale sia il tratto inteso.
checked_sources: WABCO Maintenance Manual 34 p. 34, https://www.wabco-customercentre.com/catalog/docs/mm34_web.pdf: la linea di mandata può scaricare aria all’atmosfera durante il ciclo di scarico.
WABCO Systems and Components in Commercial Vehicles p. 19, https://doc.wabco-auto.com/ProductFiles/anteros/Document/8150100033.pdf: la valvola protegge la pressione nei circuiti integri.

issues.reason: La risposta stampata VERO afferma che il veicolo non può essere messo in movimento senza pressione perché il freno a molla non si disinserisce. La fonte tecnica conferma l’azione della molla e la necessità di pressione per rilasciarla normalmente, ma osserva che molti veicoli possono comunque muoversi con il freno applicato. La portata assoluta dell’affermazione richiede adjudicazione.
checked_sources: Ontario Official Air Brake Handbook, Spring (Parking and Emergency) Brake Subsystem, https://www.ontario.ca/document/official-air-brake-handbook/spring-parking-and-emergency-brake-subsystem: l’aria comprime la molla per il rilascio, ma molti veicoli possono muoversi anche con il freno inserito.
